Thank you for letting us know. Work runs over for everyone now and then.

A missed appointment carries a $30 fee, which will be added to your next invoice. It is your first in eight visits, so there is nothing more to it than that.

Dr Shah has times free on Thursday and Friday afternoon. You can rebook here: https://northsidephysio.example/rebook

Ruth
